content:
BUILT CoLAB is one of the main sponsors of the 4th ptBIM – the Portuguese Congress of Building Information Modelling, which will take place in Braga from 4 to 6 May.

In this event, organized by the University of Minho, together with FEUP – Faculty of Engineering of the University of Porto, and IST – Instituto Superior Técnico, BUILT CoLAB counts with the participation of several of its collaborators in the presentation of their scientific papers submitted and approved by the respective scientific committee:

  • Nycolas Glerean – Automatização do Processo de Licenciamento – Metodologia e Caso de Estudo | Temática – E-Permitting;
  • Pedro N. Martins – Digital Twin para a Gestão Inteligente de Edifícios: O Caso do Smart Office do BUILT CoLAB | Temática – Digital Twin;
  • Luís Sanhudo – Proposta de Algoritmos de Inteligência Artificial para Automatização do Processo Scan-to-BIM | Temática – Scan-to-BIM;
  • Luís Sanhudo – PCMAT-30: Classificação Automática de Materiais Construtivos em Nuvens de Pontos | Temática – Laser Scanning;
  • António Aguiar Costa – BUILT CoLAB – Laboratório Colaborativo: Os Desafios RDI na Construção | Temática – BUILT CoLAB;
  • Vítor Esteves – Revisão Sistemática Sobre a Integração de Smart Contracts e BIM no Ambiente Construtivo | Temática – Blockchain;
  • Sofia Feist – Algoritmos de Aprendizagem Computacional para a Modularização de Projetos de Arquitetura | Temática – Construção Modular;
  • Pedro Ferreira – Ambiente Virtual Imersivo e Interativo para Modelos BIM: Exportação Automática e Ferramentas de Visualização | Temática – Realidade Virtual.

BUILT CoLAB will be present at the event with a stand where the team will have the opportunity to demonstrate to the participants the use of HIVE – High Interactive Virtual Environment, our application for viewing BIM models in a virtual and interactive environment (using virtual reality glasses), which allows a more realistic view of the architecture and engineering project, and consequently a greater collaboration between all its actors

You are all invited to visit us and talk to us about how you can benefit from these solutions!
